query: Mir's Name Day It's Mir's name day. They mention it casually, as if it doesn't matter. It clearly matters. Nobody else seems to know. Throw a surprise party Six friends, one cake and a banner you painted badly. Mir walks in, stops, and has to sit down. "Nobody's ever..." they start, and can't finish. Give them a handmade gift A little brass key that fits nothing. "For whatever you build next," you say. Mir wears it on a chain, every day, for years.
